|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It shows the current full-face version and text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-yoda.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates identify full-face repository revisions and the printed edition of the slip; first publication of the partial is unknown. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V7-L-yoda-2022-11-04-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V7-L-yoda-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V7-L-yoda-2022-11-04-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V7-L-yoda.gif]], 4 November 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Yoda (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-yoda022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114022426/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch5-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Yoda”. Text: “May deploy to Dagobah. Prevents attacks at same Dagobah site. Your training destiny draws are +1. If Great Warrior on table, once per turn may take your just-drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Immune to attrition.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-yodaa57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/yoda.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114022426/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch5-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Yoda” → “Yoda” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the later face prints “just drawn” without the earlier hyphen in “just-drawn”. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Yoda”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “May deploy to Dagobah. Prevents attacks at same Dagobah site. Your training destiny draws are +1. If Great Warrior on table, once per turn may take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. Immune to attrition.”

* '''Partial layout''' ([[Yoda (V) (Errata 2)]]): the September 2023 sheet edition prints a bottom-only layout with the same current text. This is the third documented image (Errata 2); the source prints no errata mark. The image-version ordinal and absent printed mark are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]].<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 3.</ref> [[File:V7-L-yoda-partial-layout-comparison-September-2023.png|thumb|center|500px|Full face and partial layout.]]
